transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess what made me come in is my eating has started feeling really out of control. After work or class, I’ll sit down with my laptop and end up eating a whole takeout meal, then chips, sweets, whatever snacks I have in my desk drawer… just way more than I meant to, and way more than I’d ever eat if someone else were around.
How do you feel after you've eaten all those snacks?

By the end, I feel really physically uncomfortable. Like my stomach gets so full and tight under my work pants that I just have to sit there for a while. If I try to move around or bend over, I feel sick.
Do you feel guilty after eating all those snacks?
I’m not totally sure how to answer that. I don’t always think “guilty” exactly, but I do feel pretty bad about it afterward, like frustrated with myself.
Do you ever try to make up for eating so much by doing something to compensate, like exercising or purging?
I don’t think so. I mean, I don’t make myself throw up or anything like that. Sometimes I think I should exercise more afterward, but I don’t really do anything specific to make up for it.
How often do these episodes of eating more than you meant to happen?
When I looked back at my journal and my food delivery charges, it’s been happening most weeks since the restructuring started. Usually more than once a week, so it’s not just every once in a while.
Are you worried about gaining weight as a result of these eating episodes?

I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’m constantly focused on my weight, but after it happens I do worry a little about what it’s doing to me. It’s more just an uncomfortable feeling than a specific fear, I guess.
Do you often think about your weight when you're not eating?
I don’t really know. I haven’t paid close attention to how often I think about it when I’m not eating. I guess it comes up sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’m constantly thinking about my weight.
How often would you say you think about your weight on a typical day?
I’m not sure exactly. I haven’t really counted it. Maybe it crosses my mind a few times, but it’s not like I’m thinking about it all day.
Would you say you think about your weight daily?
Maybe not every single day. I think it comes up some days, but I haven’t really tracked it closely.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
I’m not really sure I’d call it afraid. I don’t like the idea of gaining weight, but I haven’t really thought about whether it’s a fear exactly.
Do you think about your weight at least once a day on average?
I don’t know if it’s at least once every day on average. It probably comes up pretty often, but I haven’t paid close enough attention to say for sure.
Do you think about your weight when you're getting ready in the morning?
I’m not really sure. Sometimes when I’m getting dressed I might notice how clothes fit, but I don’t know that I’m specifically thinking about my weight every morning.
Do you think about your weight every day?
I’m not sure it’s every single day. It comes up a lot, but I haven’t really tracked it closely enough to say yes.
Do you think about your weight at least once a week?
Probably, yeah. I think it comes up at least once a week, even if I’m not keeping exact track of it.
Do you think about your weight every morning when you're getting dressed?
I don’t think it’s every morning, no. Some mornings I notice how my clothes feel or fit, but I wouldn’t say I’m thinking about my weight each time I get dressed.
Do you think about your weight every day when getting dressed or at any other time?

I’m not really sure. I don’t think it’s every day, but I haven’t paid close enough attention to say for certain. It comes up sometimes when I’m getting dressed or just during the day, but not something I can clearly say happens daily.
Do you think about your weight when you look in the mirror?
Yeah, sometimes. If I’m looking in the mirror, I might notice my body or how I look, and then my weight comes to mind. But I don’t think it happens every single time.
Do you think about your weight more than once a day?
I’m not sure. Some days it might come up more than once, like if I’m getting dressed and then see myself later, but I haven’t really kept track of it.
Do you think about your weight every time you look in the mirror?
No, I don’t think it’s every time. Sometimes I look and don’t really think much about it, but other times I notice my body and then my weight comes to mind.
Do you think about your weight every day?
I don’t know if it’s every day. It comes up pretty often, but I haven’t really paid attention enough to say for sure.
